title: Closed first cooperative two-member R admission reply (draft)
description: Reply to the existing cooperative.attach.v3 request on the original authenticated H/R admission session. R has already verified the A-signed managed-cooperative FD3 v3 reservation and two-member assignment. This H reply is only inert routing metadata: reservation_sha256 is the exact signed primary envelope hash; launch_id is the primary R launch ID, not either ACP member launch ID; broker_socket_path equals the A-signed assignment bridge broker socket. R checks these and the assignment envelope hash before provisional Hello. The B authority hash is a future join hint; its full A-signed envelope is independently verified from both later stage2a.member.attach.prepare results before any bridge_ready, ACP child attach or provider bytes. No owner ACP ticket is present. Changed or missing fields refuse.
